description: World - Wind Masts Inventory is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by Clara Ivanescu (World Bank Group). This dataset is a global inventory of known wind masts for which there is access to corresponding wind measurement data, which aims to help improve developing country's knowledge and awareness of wind resources. Users are encouraged to contribute to the development of this dataset. Coverage: Maldives, Pakistan, Vietnam, Zambia. It has 1 file in JSON. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
